name: MISP
description: Threat intelligence platform for sharing, storing, and correlating indicators of compromise and security events.

envVars.description: Public base URL of the instance

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MYSQL_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mysql"
      REDIS_FQDN: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      MISP_ADMIN_EMAIL: {{env.MISP_ADMIN_EMAIL}}
      MISP_ADMIN_PASSPHRASE: {{env.MISP_ADMIN_PASSPHRASE}}
      MISP_BASEURL: {{env.MISP_BASEURL}}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/files:/var/www/MISP/app/files
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/var/www/MISP/app/Config
      - {{appDataPath}}/gnupg:/var/www/MISP/.gnupg
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mysql
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-mysql:
    image: mysql:8
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: misp
      MYSQL_USER: misp
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
